personal_info.name: Sama Al-Oda
personal_info.tagline: I build software systems where infrastructure, biomedical apps, and on-device intelligence meet — and I ship them.

education.degree: Bachelor of Software Engineering, Double Major with Biomedical Engineering

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern (CyberDome / R&D)
bullets: Root-caused a production alert flood to bad live telemetry, then fixed the C collector so false alarms dropped from 580+/s to ∼1/s with no lost events – turning an unusable detector back into a reliable signal.

Debugged a silent telemetry failure where services appeared healthy but logs never reached monitoring, then validated end-to-end delivery across four deployment setups to catch failures before release.
Closed the loop from commit → image → install bundle, automating branch packaging and ensuring offline installs.

Designed a backup and recovery pipeline around a storage limit that blocked the usual approach, then proved backup → wipe → restore across deployments so learned system state could be recovered reliably instead of rebuilt from scratch.

experience.title: Software Developer Intern
bullets: Shipped AWS-backed REST APIs for concurrent mobile clients, covering authentication, session handling, and persistence while maintaining typical request latency under 200ms.

Built and maintained iOS and Android clients in Swift and Gradle, integrating PostgreSQL, Supabase, and Firebase to keep multi-user workflows consistent across devices and across the full client-to-backend data flow.

Turned research prototypes into product-ready services by wrapping inference behind APIs, automating data-processing pipelines, and hardening the path from notebook experiments to deployed software used in real-world mobile workflows.

projects.name: VALID: Decision-Support Platform
projects.description: Led a 10-person team to ship a multimodal decision-support backend, winning CUCAI 2026’s Responsible AI Award with 91% precision and 88% macro-recall on 120k+ unstructured records. Designed a FastAPI gateway around a BERT labeling pipeline and an ensemble of XGBoost, MLP, and Random Forest models, exposing versioned REST endpoints for downstream clients.

projects.name: Disaster Detection App
projects.description: Built an iOS app that fuses on-device sensors with a disaster-dataset API to detect hazardous events and trigger emergency alerts in under 5s, using Twilio SMS and local caching for reliable operation during connectivity loss.

projects.name: KareBear
projects.description: Shipped a cross-platform Expo app with GCP integrations for real-time audio and visual processing, plus a conversational backend, placing 2nd of 100+ teams while delivering the full application under hackathon time constraints.
